commands:
set -eu
cd /opt/phantom-ebpf
LOG=/var/log/phantom-deploy-all-20261026T092647Z.log
if bash infra/k8s/k3s-lab/deploy-all.sh >"$LOG" 2>&1; then
  echo DEPLOY_EXIT=0
  tail -100 "$LOG"
else
  rc=$?
  echo DEPLOY_EXIT=$rc
  tail -160 "$LOG"
  echo PODS
  k3s kubectl get pods -A -o wide
  echo EVENTS
  k3s kubectl get events -A --sort-by=.lastTimestamp | tail -80
  exit "$rc"
fi
